name: Israel, Gaza & region
summary: US strikes Iranian sites near Hormuz on 2 Nov as talks continue; Houthis claim Saudi attacks
state: The US carried out limited strikes on Iranian sites near Hormuz on 2 Nov, its first known strikes since September, while back-channel talks continue (AP). The Houthis claimed drone attacks on Saudi airports on 2 Nov, and the Saudi-led coalition reportedly carried out 109 strikes in 24 hours (CBS). Iran's terms include a ceasefire covering Lebanon and Gaza.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for the Middle East and the Gulf; airspace closures can change at short notice.
